# aoss_interfaces (Data Source)

Provides information about the switch's interfaces: every physical port and every trunk circuit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aoss_interfaces" "this" {}

output "interfaces" {
  value = data.aoss_interfaces.this.interfaces
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `interfaces` (List of Object) The switch interfaces: every physical port and every trunk circuit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
